exact_phase_normalization.definition: For an integer coefficient vector c_j, put C_j=c_j for even j and C_j=-i*c_j for odd j, and put a_j=(-1)^floor(j/2)c_j. Then C(z)=A(-iz) and C(i*y)=A(y).

logical_scope.diagnostic_only: Decimal values at pi and bounded {-1,0,1} candidate searches are diagnostics and are not shortest-vector or asymptotic proofs.
logical_scope.exact: Parity zeros, ranks, saturated tail kernels, HNF/LLL transformations, Smith factors, lattice indices, contents, coefficient vectors, and phase identities are exact.
logical_scope.not_a_measure_test: This certificate audits the joint lattice only. The algebraic e-measure threshold is proved in the companion source, not numerically inferred here.
logical_scope.not_classification: The finite ranks are not extrapolated and no conclusion about e+pi is claimed.
